recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-52930; any future reconsideration of DeviceMetric.status cardinality or reuse of Device.status terminology should be raised as a new work-group decision because the applied source and PR history consistently carry the current metric-specific required status design.
issue_request: FHIR-52930 was an Applied FHIR-core DeviceMetric change request resolved as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked the Devices WG to add a way to indicate the DeviceMetric record state, including invalid or no-longer-current records, with a required status binding, FiveWs.status mapping, modifier semantics for entered-in-error, and a token status search parameter.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation through HL7/fhir#3873, merged as baf35c25463da2a4616c8e226b5aeef7fb865491. Implementation commit f04b9c191ea637727687d8d5306cf076d04e12d9 added DeviceMetric.status, the DeviceMetric-status search parameter, metric-status CodeSystem/ValueSet, and an example status; follow-up commits in the same PR fixed status wording and operationalStatus alignment.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DeviceMetric as an active resource with approved status. Current source separates record status from operationalStatus: DeviceMetric.status is a required modifier code bound to metric-status and mapped to FiveWs.status, while operationalStatus is separately bound to metric-operational-status. FHIR-53367 later clarified modifier handling by adding a DeviceMetric.status modifier reason and making operationalStatus non-modifier. Devices WG Confluence minutes on 2025-10-22 and 2025-10-29 support the approved change and the operationalStatus alignment; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active DeviceMetric conformance source, search-parameter bundle, terminology files, and example already implement the accepted FHIR-52930 change as refined by related history.

related_jiras.note: Clarified DeviceMetric modifier semantics after FHIR-52930 by adding the status modifier reason and making operationalStatus non-modifier; current source reflects that later decision.
